text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is finally here. Ahead of 
her direct showdown with Tokai Teio, Nice 
Nature is unusually tense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the race began, however... 
Nice Nature learned that Tokai Teio had 
sustained an injury and scratched from the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having entered the Kikuka Sho to chase 
after her, Nice Nature suddenly lost her 
target and became flustered, unable to 
sort out her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having managed to regain her composure 
thanks to her Trainer's reassuring words, 
Nice Nature stepped forward onto the stage 
of battle.
